survey: Playground spring rider shaped as a yellow duck, shown three-quarter view facing left. The duck body sits on a blue round mounting disc fixed to the top of a coiled steel spring. The bottom of the spring is fixed to a square blue base plate that rests flat on the sand, with pebbles beside it. A red handlebar passes through the neck behind the head: a capped end with a collar sticks out on the far side and a short red knob shows on the near side, so it reads as one bar through the neck. A red saddle sits on the back between the neck and the tail, where a rider would hold the handle in front of them. The wings are moulded into the body. There are no footrests, which is an acceptable simplification.
